title: Starfall Demo Launches from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station
description: A Falcon 9 rocket carrying the Starfall Demo mission successfully launches from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Florida, on June 23, 2026. Following liftoff, the mission demonstrated SpaceX’s Starfall reentry capsule technology, supporting efforts to advance commercial access to microgravity and future cargo return capabilities. (U.S. Space Force video by Gwendolyn Kurzen)
credit: U.S. Space Force video by Gwendolyn Kurzen
